milestones.title: Load-test run file from the rig reaching the target stage, or the stage reached recorded with its reason

remediation: Provide the load-test rig, run the load test to the target stage with start bursts, and commit the hashed run file. A stage the rig does not reach is recorded as not reached with its reason; capacity figures in docs come only from the run file.
title: The hosted deployment has no recorded load test at the target session count
